horizon_risk.caveat: Block-bootstrap simulation of the real P2-governed 6-leg ladder (same compute_sizing() the live watchdogs call), NOT a live-account realized track record. mdd_*_pct_of_equity is the key read: the dollar MDD generally grows as the ladder scales up, but it shrinks as a SHARE of the (also-growing) account -- that's the 'getting safer as we scale' effect, and where it stops improving is worth watching, not assuming.

outage_retro_sessions.reason: Outage retro: bot down through the 09:33 ET anchor; position opened by a manual retroactive order ~14:27 UTC. Actual fill P&L stays in the ledger as OUTAGE_RETRO (not a frozen-spec execution, excluded from clean-live statistics); the hypothetical backfill lead-in is shown separately, never summed.
outage_retro_sessions.treatment: actual fill = OUTAGE_RETRO row; backfill = BACKTEST row (missed entry -> retro entry); consecutive segments of one position, both in the ledger

projection.caveat: Real 3-year backtest window (2023-08-21..2026-08-20) at TODAY's live contract sizing, not the live account's own realized rate (too few real days to measure that yet). MDD figures are the observed historical-window figure at this sizing, not a statistically projected annual MDD -- drawdown magnitude does not scale with elapsed time the way P&L does, so it should not be annualized.
